entries.title: Concealing it from the skilled observer
entries.literal_meaning: Like hiding one’s belly from the midwife.
entries.explanation: The example follows the definition of a skilled midwife. Our reading takes the contrast as attempted concealment from someone familiar with the matter. It is an analogy about expertise, not proof that any practitioner knows everything or a demand to disclose intimate information.
entries.meaning_odia: ଦକ୍ଷ ପ୍ରସବସହାୟିକାର ସଂଜ୍ଞା ପରେ ଏହି ତୁଳନା ଆସିଛି। ଆମ ପାଠରେ, ଯିଏ ବିଷୟଟି ଜାଣନ୍ତି ତାଙ୍କଠାରୁ ସେହି କଥା ଲୁଚାଇବାର ଚେଷ୍ଟା ଏଠି ଦିଶେ। ଏହା ଦକ୍ଷତାକୁ ନେଇ ଉପମା; କେହି ସବୁ ଜାଣନ୍ତି ବା ନିଜର ଗୋପନ କଥା କହିବାକୁ ବାଧ୍ୟ ବୋଲି ନିୟମ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading concerns attempted concealment from someone with relevant experience.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ସମ୍ପୃକ୍ତ ଅଭିଜ୍ଞତା ଥିବା ଲୋକଙ୍କଠାରୁ କଥା ଲୁଚାଇବାର ଚେଷ୍ଟାକୁ ଦେଖେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଭଙ୍ଗା କବାଟର ଖରାପ କବଜାଟିକୁ ରଙ୍ଗରେ ଢାଙ୍କିଦିଆଗଲା। ମରାମତି କାରିଗର କବାଟ ଖୋଲି ସେହି ତ୍ରୁଟି ଦେଖିଲେ। / A repairer notices a faulty hinge beneath fresh paint. This invented analogy is not a medical encounter.
entries.cultural_context: The source labels this a Dhaga comparison under midwife, distinct from the earlier wet-nurse sense. No diagnosis, historical incident or customary disclosure rule is established.

entries.odia: କେତେବେଳେ ଜୋଡ଼ା ମାଇପରେ ଘର କେତେବେଳେ ଚୂଲୀ ଫୁଙ୍କି ଫୁଙ୍କି ମର
entries.title: A household’s changing circumstances
entries.literal_meaning: At times, a home with two wives; at times, blow and blow at the hearth until you die.
entries.explanation: The repeated “at times” turns a household image into an exhausting cooking complaint. The source gives no cause for the change. Our critical reading notices that the contrast relies on an expectation of women’s kitchen labour; describing that expectation does not make cooking their obligation.
entries.meaning_odia: ବାରମ୍ବାର ଆସୁଥିବା “କେତେବେଳେ” ଘରର ଚିତ୍ରକୁ ରାନ୍ଧି ରାନ୍ଧି ହାଲିଆ ହେବାର ଅଭିଯୋଗ ସହ ଯୋଡ଼େ। ଏହି ବଦଳର କାରଣ ଉତ୍ସ କହେନାହିଁ। ଆମ ସମାଲୋଚନାମୂଳକ ପାଠରେ ଏଠି ନାରୀଙ୍କ ରୋଷେଇ ଶ୍ରମ ଉପରେ ଆଶା ରଖାଯାଇଛି; ସେହି ଆଶାକୁ ବୁଝିବା ଅର୍ଥ ରୋଷେଇ କେବଳ ତାଙ୍କ ଦାୟିତ୍ୱ ବୋଲି ମାନିବା ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our critical reading distinguishes a household complaint from an obligation imposed on women.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ଘରର ଅଭିଯୋଗକୁ ନାରୀଙ୍କ ଉପରେ ଥୋପାଯାଇଥିବା ଦାୟିତ୍ୱଠାରୁ ଅଲଗା କରେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ପାଠଚକ୍ରରେ ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ପଢ଼ି ସମସ୍ତେ ରୋଷେଇ କାମ କିଏ କରେ ବୋଲି ଆଲୋଚନା କଲେ। ନିଜ ସଭାର ଭୋଜନ ପାଇଁ ସେମାନେ କାମ ବାଣ୍ଟିନେଲେ। / Readers discuss the complaint and share the work of preparing their meeting’s meal. This response is invented, not the saying’s traditional moral.
entries.cultural_context: The quotation follows the figurative cooking sense. Its death wording is rhetorical here, not an established death event; no marriage history or reason for absence is supplied.

entries.odia: ଗୁଳ୍ଜି ସୁଆଁ ପାଚିଲା, ଖାଡ଼ିଆ ବୁଡ଼ା ନାଚଲା
entries.title: Grain ripens, an elder dances
entries.literal_meaning: Gulji suan ripened; the Kharia elder danced.
entries.explanation: The line joins ripening grain to one elder’s dance. The dictionary’s note describes gathering and cooking this grain. Our reading attends to the connection between available food and delight, without making the named figure stand for everyone in a community or turning the dance into a documented ritual.
entries.meaning_odia: ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ଶସ୍ୟ ପାଚିବା ସହ ଜଣେ ବୃଦ୍ଧଙ୍କ ନାଚକୁ ଯୋଡ଼େ। ଅଭିଧାନର ଟୀକାରେ ଏହି ଶସ୍ୟ ସଂଗ୍ରହ କରି ରାନ୍ଧିବା କଥା ଅଛି। ଆମ ପାଠ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ମିଳିବା ଓ ଆନନ୍ଦର ସମ୍ପର୍କକୁ ଦେଖେ; ଜଣେ ପାତ୍ରକୁ ପୂରା ସମୁଦାୟର ସ୍ୱଭାବ ବା ନାଚକୁ ପ୍ରମାଣିତ ପର୍ବ ବୋଲି ଧରେନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading follows the verse’s food-and-delight connection without generalising a community.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ଓ ଆନନ୍ଦର ଯୋଗକୁ ଦେଖେ, ସମୁଦାୟ ବିଷୟରେ ସାଧାରଣ ନିୟମ କରେନାହିଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ପାଠଚକ୍ରରେ ଜଣେ କହିଲେ, “ଏହି ଲୋକଟିର ଆନନ୍ଦକୁ ଦେଖିବା, ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କ ସ୍ୱଭାବ ବୋଲି କହିବା ନାହିଁ।” / A reader asks the group to attend to the individual’s delight rather than make a community stereotype. This discussion is invented.
entries.cultural_context: Sambalpur labels the headword, not a proven saying origin. The historical note’s community and poverty classifications remain attributed source language, not present-day ethnography or botanical identification.
